errors.text_span: с етикети на всеки две години
errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis has labels every two years, but the chart clearly shows labels for every single year from 2001 to 2021.

errors.text_span: започва от стойност около 100 през 2004 година
errors.evidence: The description for the red line (BG40) states it starts in 2004 with a value of around 100. The line actually starts in 2005 at a value of approximately 230 on the right y-axis.

errors.text_span: достига връх от около 1400 през 2007 година
errors.evidence: The description mistakenly reads the peak of the BG40 line (red) from the left y-axis (SOFIX scale). According to its correct right y-axis, the peak is approximately 450, not 1400.
The description states the BG40 line drops below 100 in 2009. The chart shows its low point around 2009 is approximately 200 on the right y-axis.

errors.text_span: След 2010 година стойностите ѝ остават ниски, около или под 100
errors.evidence: The description claims that after 2010, the BG40 line's values are around or below 100. In reality, the line fluctuates between approximately 200 and 300 on the right y-axis before it terminates.
The description implies the red line (BG40) continues to the end of the period (2021). However, the line is not plotted after approximately 2014.
The description states the green line (BGBX40) starts in 2013. The line actually starts in early 2014.
The description states the green line (BGBX40) reaches a value of about 200 by 2021. The chart shows its final value is closer to 150 on the right y-axis.
